name: Azure Application Deletion
description: Deleting an Entra application can knock out a line of business app, or it can hide a backdoor the attacker already used. Sometimes they delete an app they created so the weekly app review never sees it. Either way, someone with application-admin rights is changing the identity fabric. Unexpected application deletion belongs in the same bucket as unexpected user deletion.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
